sourceReference.packageCommitProvenance: The 1.25.0 nuspec does not declare a source commit; the source SHA is a separate observation.

probes.name: concurrent receivers and serialized same receiver
assertions: B entered while A1 was blocked, proving receiver-level overlap in this execution.
A1 and A2 were queued to the same receiver; their handler active-count never exceeded one.

probes.name: round barrier holds fast branch next step for slow branch
fan-in duplicate buffering survives partial checkpoint and resume
assertions: Source A processed two messages but they did not release the fan-in barrier before checkpoint.
After checkpoint resume and one source B message, all three arrivals reached the join.

limitations: This is an in-process execution probe of the released NuGet package, not proof of distributed execution or Elsa hosting semantics.
No LLM, connector, external network, retry, metrics, cancellation, or crash-after-side-effect behavior is exercised.
The fan-in checkpoint probe uses the package in-memory checkpoint manager; it does not prove durable storage or cross-process restore.
